Maria Gonzales: Quick sync — trying to onboard zeta-4b for staging. HF path is `hf://redwood/models/zeta-4b/` and we pushed a mirror to `s3://rwd-artifacts/models/zeta-4b/2026-03-16/`. Can someone sanity-check checksums and tokenizer files?
Aj Patel: On it. Do we have a manifest with expected digests?
Maria Gonzales: There's a `manifest.json` in the HF repo but it's missing the tokenizer sha. HF has `tokenizer.json` + `vocab.txt`. Mirror has `tokenizer.json` but `merges.txt` is absent. Not sure if that will break our tokenizer loader.
Sam Liu: Missing `merges.txt` will break sentencepiece-bpe path. Which tokenizer type is this supposed to be?
Maria Gonzales: The model was exported from a transformers setup using `BPE` with merges. Upstream HF shows `tokenizer.json` + `merges.txt` in the original but the mirror drop was a partial rsync.
Aj Patel: I pulled the HF artifacts and ran a quick checksum:
```
aws s3 cp s3://rwd-artifacts/models/zeta-4b/2026-03-16/model.bin ./model.bin
sha256sum model.bin
# expected: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
```
Aj Patel: The mirror model.bin checksum matches HF's manifest but tokenizer files differ — HF `merges.txt` hash != mirror (mirror missing entries).
artifact-bot: mirror-sync job #724 completed with status WARN. Missing objects: tokenizer/merges.txt.
Maria Gonzales: Ok thanks. Two asks: (1) Aj — can you re-run mirror job with `--include "tokenizer/*"` and confirm ACLs? (2) Sam — can you patch our tokenizer loader to fall back to `tokenizer.json`-only mode (with a warning) so staging can boot?
Aj Patel: Will re-run mirror now. Quick command I use: `aws s3 sync hf-mirror/ s3://rwd-artifacts/models/zeta-4b/2026-03-16/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control --exclude "*" --include "tokenizer/*"`
Aj Patel: Also noticed the S3 object ACL for the mirror prefix was `private` but our registry role expects `bucket-owner-full-control`. I'll set an object-level acl during sync.
Sam Liu: I can add a safe fallback in the loader: if merges missing, log `WARNING: merges.txt missing — using tokenizer.json heuristics` and still load. I will add a unit test and a small eval prompt to ensure it doesn't regress.
Maria Gonzales: That sounds good. Also we should update `manifest.json` in HF mirror to include `tokenizer.merges.sha256` after sync.
Aj Patel: Re-sync started (job 725). ETA ~3m. I'll paste logs when done.
artifact-bot: job 725 finished SUCCESS. Added objects: tokenizer/merges.txt; updated manifest.json.
Aj Patel: Verified manifests and checksums: tokenizer.merges.sha256 = 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015. S3 ACLs set to bucket-owner-full-control.
Maria Gonzales: Perfect. Sam — when you open the PR, please ping @eng-ml and add the eval snippet. I want this in staging before tomorrow's rollout. :thumbsup:
Sam Liu: Will do. PR in ~15m.
Maria Gonzales: Thanks everyone — closing the loop. If anything fails during staging boot I'll @Aj for quick rollback of the mirror.
